main.description: One immutable version of a provenance record. Never updated; chained to its parent twice, by contentHash and by strong reference.

record.description: The head record this is a version of.

recordId.description: The provenance id; the key of the head.

parentHash.description: The previous version's contentHash; absent on version 1.

parent.description: The previous version record; absent on version 1.

reason.description: Why this version exists; required after version 1.

commit.description: Git commit the version was published from.

specHashes.description: One entry per content.associatedSpecs, in the same order.

baseVersion.description: For origin ui: the version the editor started from.

baseContentHash.description: For origin ui: that version's contentHash.
